title: Marguerite and the Thorn
author: T. M. Eriksen
blurb: Wren Winterbourne, an exiled storm-caller, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
